energy.scope: Continuous observed segment of gross hardware CPU-package and GPU-board energy, including idle, waiting and unrelated system work. Not isolated process energy or measured socket electricity. Earlier uncovered intervals are unknown and are never extrapolated.

Continuous observed segment of gross hardware CPU-package and GPU-board energy, including idle, waiting and unrelated system work. Not isolated process energy or measured socket electricity. Earlier uncovered intervals are unknown and are never extrapolated.

Gross host CPU-package and GPU-board cumulative counter difference across one verified boot. Intermediate waiting and gaps inside these monotonic endpoints are included by the hardware counters; no power interpolation or sum of overlapping jobs. Bootstrap/download interval before the first counter boundary remains unmeasured. Not wall-socket electricity. Later accounting-summary publication is a separately recorded bookkeeping operation; raw counters remain private.
